verdict.rationale: Metorial is an MCP hosting and integration platform, so a browser-based tool playground or inspector is a fair question for it. The evidence never shows an interactive way to invoke an MCP server's tools from the browser before integrating. The Agents area and trace review only inspect tool calls after agents have run, and connection URLs are meant for external MCP clients. That is post-hoc observability and client wiring, not a playground.
